statistics.quality_delta: after minus before; canonical two-stage paired item bootstrap
statistics.ratio: after/before ratio of arithmetic means; canonical _paired_ratio
statistics.decode: arithmetic mean of per-request rates, not total tokens/total time
statistics.multiplicity: Intervals are nominal exploratory per-metric intervals, not familywise adjusted.

limits: Five pairs per axis; zero discordance is not ±5pp equivalence.
No across-model or across-axis pooling and no composite quality ranking.
Prose quality requires paired human/source review, not equality hashes.
Short-request memory telemetry is not capacity evidence; assess separate matched capacity probes.
Combined latest source bundle (C85 lifetime/logical-trim repairs and upstream updates) plus native16-only session retirement; not an isolated bugfix, kernel or cache-policy effect.
Actual-stack combined-bundle comparison, not original C77 old/upstream-runtime comparison; no isolated source or retirement-policy attribution.
Time order is before then after; same-session matching does not isolate every temporal/system effect.
